content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to simulate communication between a [product_name] (software version [version_no]) and a [product_name] HMI panel using [product_name] engineering software ([version_no])?

Yes, but you can only simulate the HMI panel. The [product_name] controller cannot be simulated, so you'll need to connect a real [product_name] device. Additionally, to simulate the HMI panel, you need to use a PLC simulation tool that matches your engineering software's version.

I'm aware of the PLC simulation tool. My question was more about whether both the [product_name] controller and [product_name] HMI panel can be simulated together without actual hardware. Thank you for clarifying my doubt.
No, the [product_name] controller cannot be simulated to communicate with other devices or simulations virtually.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to simulate communication between a [product_name] controller and an HMI panel using engineering software. They find that only the HMI can be simulated in the virtual environment, while the [product_name] controller needs to be physically present, limiting fully virtual testing options. Users know about PLC simulation tools for HMIs, but there is a lack of simulation capability for [product_name] controllers without hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to simulate both the [product_name] controller and HMI panel entirely in software, with no need for physical devices.
